reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Rapidly march towards elimination of new HIV infections and ending AIDS as a public health threat by 2025, Increase Access to and Improve Quality of TB Diagnosis and Treatment at OD and Community levels, with linkages to TB-HIV in Cambodia - Cambodia (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Cambodia, TB/HIV, Cambodia Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF)This program has the following goals: Ending AIDS as a public health threat in Cambodia by 2025. To reduce TB death by 90% and Incidence by 80% in 2030. The objectives of this program are: Avert new infections to less than 250 by 2025 through tailored and customized prevention interventions. To Find and treat all Tuberculosis cases early using more sensitive screening and diagnostic tools as well as new and more effective treatment regimens, from 2021 to 2023.. Intensify targeted case detection to achieve the 1st 95. To Address the programme specific needs and priorities (Community DOTS/Community TB Care, MDR TB, TB/HIV, TB in prisons, etc, from 2021 to 2023.. Uphold the 2nd 95 to ensure the 3rd 95 through universal coverage of quality HIV-related services along the HIV cascade of care. To Prevent the emergence of TB in susceptible populations using TB Preventive Treatment (TPT) approaches, from 2021 to 2023.. Sustain a robust national response through integration and securing domestic fiscual space for HIV
